facts.subject: Ymir Locks
facts.statement: Ymir Locks joins the West Sea and the East Sea.

source_ref.text_snippet: Ymir Locks joins the West Sea and the East Sea.

facts.subject: Bifrost Strait
facts.statement: Bifrost Strait joins the East Sea and the Inner Sea.

source_ref.text_snippet: Bifrost Strait joins the East Sea and the Inner Sea.

facts.subject: Ravik Rail Link
facts.statement: Ravik Rail Link carries traffic overland between the eastern and western sides.

source_ref.text_snippet: Ravik Rail Link carries traffic overland between the eastern and western sides.

facts.subject: Ymir Locks
facts.statement: Ymir Locks is a stepped canal with scheduled crossings, pilotage and maintenance windows.

source_ref.text_snippet: Ymir Locks is a stepped canal with scheduled crossings, pilotage and maintenance windows.

facts.subject: Bifrost Strait
facts.statement: Bifrost Strait is a deep-water passage used by container ships, tankers and bulk carriers, with a pilotage service and a traffic separation scheme.

source_ref.text_snippet: Bifrost Strait is a deep-water passage used by container ships, tankers and bulk carriers, with a pilotage service and a traffic separation scheme.

facts.subject: Ravik Rail Link
facts.statement: Ravik Rail Link combines a rail line and a parallel road.

source_ref.text_snippet: Ravik Rail Link combines a rail line and a parallel road.

facts.subject: Southern Sea path
facts.statement: The Southern Sea path is an open-water route around the southern coast; it is longer than the strait and is used by some carriers in normal times.

source_ref.text_snippet: The Southern Sea path is an open-water route around the southern coast; it is longer than the strait and is used by some carriers in normal times.

facts.subject: Cargo routes
facts.statement: Each route has a single fixed path.

source_ref.text_snippet: Each route has a single fixed path.

facts.subject: Cargo switching
facts.statement: Cargoes do not switch between the locks, the strait and the land bridge within the same route.

source_ref.text_snippet: Cargoes do not switch between the locks, the strait and the land bridge within the same route.
